tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Every card's background, always. No card is ever tinted, patterned or dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, headings, conclusions, statement and emphasis lines, .cn-strong phrases, the QuoteBox border and the Tag fill. 18.9:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running body text (BodyText paragraphs) on paper. 12.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting info only: captions, image sources, author handle, placeholder labels. 4.5:1 on paper, 4.1:1 on placeholder (24px+ text, passes 3:1).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: The one colour in the system: the highlighter behind headings (.cn-mark). Never on body text, never as a fill elsewhere.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The 1px divider on the cover between AuthorRow and the image. Nothing else.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Fill of an image slot that has no image yet, with ink-muted size text on it.

families.sans: "Nanum Gothic", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: CoverCard title only. One sentence, two lines at most.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: One per Card and OpinionCard, always with the mint .cn-mark behind it.

styles.name: emphasis
styles.usage: ThoughtCard's closing question to the reader, centred.

styles.name: quote
styles.usage: Inside QuoteBox only. The only serif in the system.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 겨우 그거 하나 다녀온다고 인생이 변하지도 않을 거고,
styles.usage: All body paragraphs. Never resized per card.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: .cn-strong inside a paragraph (once per paragraph) and the Conclusion line.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The black Tag on OpinionCard only.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Image sources, author handle, placeholder labels. The smallest size: nothing goes below 24px.

tokens.name: pad-y
tokens.usage: Card padding, top and bottom.

tokens.name: pad-x
tokens.usage: Card padding, left and right.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Text column and image width (1080 minus 2 × pad-x).

tokens.name: gap-lg
tokens.usage: Heading to body, and before the Conclusion.

tokens.name: gap-md
tokens.usage: Where the flow changes: body to QuoteBox, QuoteBox to closing lines, Tag to heading.

tokens.name: gap-sm
tokens.usage: Between paragraphs; between the stacked parts of the cover.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: cards, images, Tag, QuoteBox, placeholders.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The author's profile photo in AuthorRow. Nothing else is round.

size.note: Fixed canvas and image sizes, in card pixels.

tokens.name: card-width
tokens.usage: Instagram portrait card width.

tokens.name: card-height
tokens.usage: Instagram portrait card height (4:5).

tokens.name: hero-height
tokens.usage: Cover hero image height at content-width (900 × 675, 4:3).

tokens.name: avatar-size
tokens.usage: Profile photo diameter in AuthorRow.

tokens.name: sticker-min
tokens.usage: Narrowest corner illustration on a Card.

tokens.name: sticker-max
tokens.usage: Widest corner illustration on a Card.

border.note: Only two lines exist in the system.

tokens.name: border-divider
tokens.usage: Cover divider, coloured line.

tokens.name: border-quote
tokens.usage: QuoteBox outline, coloured ink.
